curationPolicy.priority: Equal identity, visual and provenance scrutiny for every reviewed label. Census abundance weights gallery depth: 6–8 useful photos at 10,000+ records, 4 at 2,000–9,999, around 3 below 2,000. Targets are not quotas or minimums for inclusion.
curationPolicy.selection: Prefer documented Bengaluru/Karnataka, then Indian capture locations; otherwise the best eligible reference. Prefer recognisable whole-tree views first, followed by complementary medium and diagnostic detail views. Never infer capture location from photographer nationality.
curationPolicy.limitations: Covered means a reference gallery exists, not that whole-tree coverage or the target count is complete. Framing and remaining gaps are tracked separately. Explicitly scoped reference illustrations do not resolve uncertain census identities; genus examples do not assign a species to census records.
curationPolicy.scope: All 235 named census labels; this published checkpoint is not the completed campaign.
curationPolicy.identity: Preserve exact census labels. Document unambiguous canonical/synonym mappings and spelling/authority corrections using taxonomic evidence. Do not guess conflicting species or discard qualified ranks.
curationPolicy.counts: Framing/location totals derive from selected per-photo evidence, not stale checkpoint summary fields. Unclassified framing is not counted as a whole-tree view.
